notes.title: Games forged in Germany Feature
notes.content: [h1]BILDSCHIRMSPIELENTWICKLERSIMULATOR [/h1][p]The Games You Make is part of the large german showcase [b]Games Forged In Germany[/b]. Fresh out of the forge, we're quenching the new trailer and tempering it for your curious eyes.[/p][p]In the past year, we have added many features, bugs and environments to the library of mayhem:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929140/6b0bdaa9a9c97149d32a1b61b7d77104daa8809c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Sounds, Particles and new tilesets are all at your disposal to make the best indie game. [/p][p]The most requested feature also has made it into the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929140/8293e25efe0f3c63caef3bed66399e61ceb80de5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are looking forward to a fun festival week, check out our friends over at the festival page and we will see you for the launch of the demo! Don't forget to wishlist to get notified. For anyone willing to test the game EARLY, we are looking for [url="https://jumpybit.com/tgym/beta.html"]beta testers[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]You can reach out for preview keys if you're a streamer in the curious, creative or cozy department via our [url="https://jumpybit.com/presskit/"]press email[/url].[/p][p]Check out all the other games in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany Event[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852750/The_Games_You_Make/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
